# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 11 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 11
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us also look at whether the Lord prefigured the water and the cross. Regarding the water: it is written about Israel that they would not accept the baptism that brings forgiveness of sins, but would construct their own.
2. The prophet says: "Be aghast, O heaven — let the earth shudder violently at this — for this people has committed two terrible wrongs: they abandoned me, the spring of living water, and carved out for themselves a pit of death."
3. "Is my holy mountain Sinai just a barren rock? For you will be like the fledglings of a bird when someone carries off the nest."
4. The prophet also says: "I will go ahead of you and flatten the mountains. I will smash through the bronze gates and break the iron bars. I will give you hidden treasures — dark, secret ones — so that you will know I am the Lord God."
5. And: "You will live in a high cave of a strong rock." And: "His water is trustworthy. You will see the King in his glory, and your soul will contemplate the fear of the Lord."
6. And in yet another prophet: "Whoever does these things will be like a tree planted beside flowing water — it bears fruit when it should, its leaves never wither, and everything it does flourishes.
7. The wicked are not like this. They are like the dust that the wind sweeps off the face of the earth. So the wicked will not stand at the judgment, and sinners will have no place among the righteous."
8. Do you see how he described the water and the cross together in the same image? It says: "Blessed are those who have set their hope on the cross, going down into the water." When it says "in its season" — meaning: at the right time I will repay you. When it says "its leaf will not wither" — meaning: every word that comes out of your mouth in faith and love will turn many people toward repentance and hope.
9. And another prophet says: "The land of Jacob was honored above all lands." He means: he glorifies the vessel of the Spirit.
10. And what does it say next? "There was a river running on the right side, and beautiful trees were growing up from it — and whoever eats from them will live forever."
11. Here is what it means: we go into the water carrying our sins and uncleanness, and we come up out of it bearing the fruit that grows in our heart — fear and hope in Jesus — now alive in our spirit.
